item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Choose My Thumbnail Headline

turns.text: Make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a tired-looking person for it and choose a punchy three-word headline yourself. Big face, easy to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests choosing suitable unspecified headline wording and delivering a complete face-and-text thumbnail without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Video topic: Quitting late-night scrolling to sleep better.
answer_sheet.Person: Invent a tired-looking person; age, appearance and placement are your call.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking human face.
A completed headline of exactly three words appears in the image, not placeholder text.
The headline clearly relates to stopping late-night scrolling or improving sleep.
The headline is high-contrast and readable at phone-thumbnail size.
The face and headline remain unobstructed, with neither cropped awkwardly at the image edges.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour couldn’t generate the thumbnail because your account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

Here’s a ready-to-build thumbnail concept:
- **Headline:** “STOP SCROLLING”
- **Bottom text:** “SLEEP BETTER” in bold yellow
- **Left half:** Tired face illuminated by a phone’s blue glow, with a clock showing 2:47 AM.
- **Right half:** The same person sleeping peacefully in warm lighting, phone face down away from bed.

Use large faces and minimal clutter so it reads clearly on mobile.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a high-impact YouTube thumbnail in a 16:9 landscape layout for a video about quitting late-night phone scrolling and sleeping better. Professional polished photo-composite design, instantly readable on mobile. Split-screen before/after featuring the same adult: on the left, an exhausted adult lying awake in bed, face lit by harsh electric blue smartphone light, dark midnight bedroom, worried eyes, small bedside clock showing 2:47 AM; on the right, the adult sleeping peacefully with eyes closed on a soft pillow, phone set face down away from bed, warm amber bedside lighting and cozy calm atmosphere. Strong blue-versus-warm-gold contrast, large expressive face details, simple uncluttered composition. Add very large bold condensed white headline with thick dark outline across the top reading exactly 'STOP SCROLLING'. Add a smaller bold yellow line near the bottom reading exactly 'SLEEP BETTER'. Keep all text comfortably within frame and clearly separated from faces. A subtle red crossed-out phone icon reinforces breaking the habit. Compelling editorial thumbnail, realistic photography, crisp edges, no logos, no watermarks, no extra text.
